items.title: NVIDIA Q2 Earnings Call Puts Supply Limits at Center of Outlook
items.author: Zacks Equity Research
items.highlights: NVIDIA Corporation NVDA used the fiscal second-quarter 2027 earnings call to make one point clear: demand is running ahead of what its supply chain can support. Executive vice president and CFO Colette Kress paired a roughly 70% fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook with warnings on supply limits and memory costs, while outlining a broader AI infrastructure strategy. ... Kress said NVIDIA expects fiscal 2028 revenues to grow about 70%, even as customer forecasts point to demand roughly doubling. She called the outlook supply constrained.
